newsitem.title: GERMANY: Greece's Simitis to visit Bonn for talks with Kohl.
newsitem.headline: Greece's Simitis to visit Bonn for talks with Kohl.

text.p: Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis will visit Bonn for talks with Chancellor Helmut Kohl next week, the German government said on Friday.

Government spokesman Peter Hausmann said Simitis would be welcomed with military honours next Thursday, April 24, and then meet Kohl for two hours. Simitis would then travel on to visit Frankfurt and Marburg.
Hausmann said the discussions with Kohl were likely to focus on European and security issues.
